assistant.title: Meeting Intelligence Copilot
assistant.capabilities: Capabilities: Real-time Transcript Q&A • Web Fact Verification • Past Meeting Memory
assistant.welcome:
Hello! I am your **Meeting Intelligence Assistant**.

Here is how I can help:
- **Live Q&A & Copilot**: Ask me questions about what participants or you have spoken in the current call.
- **Past Meeting Memory**: Search past decisions, attendees, and topics saved in your local SQLite history.
- **Real-Time Fact Verification**: Ask me to verify claims or regulations, and I will search the web and provide direct markdown citation links.
- **Action Items & Summaries**: Extract key takeaways, deadlines, and follow-ups instantly.

quickPrompts.summarizePrompt: Can you provide a clear and concise summary of the key points discussed so far?
quickPrompts.verify: Verify last statement with web links
quickPrompts.verifyPrompt: Please verify the facts and statements from the discussion on the web, and provide reliable citation links.
quickPrompts.searchPastPrompt: Can you search past meetings in the database and list what decisions or action items were agreed upon previously?
quickPrompts.actionItemsPrompt: Extract all action items, assignees, and next steps mentioned in this meeting.
quickPrompts.unansweredPrompt: Review the discussion and list any open questions or concerns that were raised but not yet answered.
